name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: REINIT-CERTVERIFIER-EXPERIMENT BUILD, not for production: runs cleanup on two triggers -- app shutdown and new compose window open -- and, when cleanup actually removes a stale cert9.db row, rebuilds Gecko's process-lifetime CertVerifier singleton from scratch (by toggling security.enterprise_roots.enabled false->true, an existing unpatched mechanism -- see nsNSSComponent::UpdateCertVerifierWithEnterpriseRoots) to test whether that clears whatever in-memory cache (mTrustCache/mSignatureCache, found via source research) goes stale. Replaces 0.4.30's PK11-token-logout/login attempt, which had zero observable effect.
